description: Windows desktop video downloader. Paste a link from almost any site; also serves the Astra Deck browser extension over a local API.
notes: This package installs the portable one-folder layout, so Astra Downloader keeps its state in the data folder beside the executable rather than in %LOCALAPPDATA%.
That whole folder is persisted, so an update keeps your settings, history, queue, subscriptions and stored sign-ins, and does not download yt-dlp, FFmpeg or the JavaScript runtime again.
'scoop uninstall -p astra-downloader' removes that folder along with the app.
